title: Acting As Banner
summary: A sticky bar that says whose account you are acting as, and labels destructive buttons with the org they act on, so support staff don't edit the wrong data.
description: Shows a sticky "You're acting as…" bar with who is really signed in, a countdown to when impersonation ends and a switch-back action, plus an org chip that makes each destructive button say where it acts.
catches: Forgetting you are impersonating a customer
Destructive buttons that don't say which org they act on (via the org chip)
A failed switch back, shown as an error
limits: Shows the session you describe in props; it doesn't create or end impersonation
The org chip only appears where you add it
a11y: A role="region" with an aria-label naming who you act as and the org
The org colour is decorative; the org is always named in text
server: Scope impersonation sessions on the server, log every action with both the actor and the subject, and expire sessions server-side.
stops: Edited a customer's data as myself
mistakes: forgot i was logged in as user
